Bṛhaspatismṛti
dh. one of the smṛti texts most frequently quoted by smṛti texts such a. Gautama an. later nibandha texts. As the text cites Manu quite often an. the text amplifies the principles laid down in Manusmṛti, it is held by Bu7hler that the Bṛhaspatismṛti is a vārttika on Manusmṛti; it has prob. attained its final form before 4th Cent.; originally it seems to have existed in prose an. verse form dealing with the topics of both Arthaśāstra an. Dharmaśāstra. See Intro. p.. 1-185 of GOS. edn. noted below. C.. also Bārhaspatyārthaśāstra, NCC. XIII. p. 263a. For a. observation of the GOS. edn. noted below see [Page097-b] Louis Renou, Ind. Iranian Journal VI (1962) p.. 81-102. See also Kane, HDS. I. i. p.. 484-95.
